base_delta_summary: SCRUM-105 durable contracts and SCRUM-142 supporting graph/task artifacts merged; validator and G0/G1 schemas unchanged.

event_projection.logical_event_name: stored as the node/event outcome label while canonical event identity uses event_id and sequence
event_projection.actor_and_gate: actor, node and gate fields in durable-event
event_projection.result: outcome plus evidence references in durable-event
event_projection.run_binding: durable-run binds run_id, task, repository, gate, runtime version and current checkpoint
event_projection.resume_binding: durable-checkpoint binds current/next node, next action, scope hash, revision, lease and fencing token
event_projection.external_effect_boundary: pending-action binds intent, idempotency, unknown outcome and deterministic readback

scrum_142.limitation: Repository-derived UA-compatible snapshot; not evidence of a direct full UA engine run.
